requirement_text: ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS 2026/2027 INTAKE. All applicants whose first language is not English must demonstrate proficiency; the certificate must have been issued within 2 years of the expected start date. Undergraduate (Non-EU) minimums include: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in each band; Duolingo English Test (DET) 120 with at least 110 in each subscore; TOEFL iBT 90 with no less than 21 in writing and at least 19 in all other sections (or, on the iBT 0-6 scale, 5 overall with no less than 4.5 in all sections); Pearson Test of English 63 with no less than 59 per item; Cambridge Proficiency/Advanced Certificate 176+ with no less than 169 in each skill (Grade C or better / CEFR C1-C2). Students who completed a full bachelor's degree taught through English in Ireland, the UK, USA, Australia, New Zealand, Nigeria or Canada may be exempt.
